column3: A New Captain chunk that fails renders an error boundary in the shell whose fallback is the same Dialog with #89's Stopped and Try again; closing it clears the open state, and the next press resets the boundary so the load is retried. A failed create shows its error as a wrapping role=alert line at the end of the dialog body instead of a truncated footer span, and returns focus to the Name field
column4: Review of #95: a failed chunk left newCaptainOpen true with nothing on screen, so the button did nothing for the session; the Dialog footer is a fixed 56px row, so a long error could not wrap there without overflowing
column5: chunks.test.ts 'a New Captain chunk that fails shows Try again in the dialog, and the next press retries'; new-captain.test.ts 'a create that fails'
